author: root
scope: Independent review of the current diff for history/core/cli/render and complete new semantic.py; no source code or historical pool records changed.

findings.title: Missing checkpoint metadata silently removes the 2000-row protection
findings.trigger: checkpoint-2000.json is missing or renamed before rebuilding; the 1000 baseline remains present.
findings.evidence: The isolated fixture copied the real 2000 checkpoint, altered B2050.answer_target in memory, and confirmed rejection with metadata present. Renaming only the temporary metadata made validateCheckpoints return []; the remaining mandatory 1000 baseline also accepted the changed row. Actual repository snapshots were untouched.
findings.impact: A rebuild can bind the reduced input list and accept edits to rows introduced after the first 1000. readPool drift detection before rebuilding does not restore the missing history requirement.
findings.required_change: Read a required, nonempty checkpoint registry in both intake and validation. Require every declared metadata and snapshot file, validate its hash, and bind the registry to the input snapshot. Missing, renamed, empty, duplicate or malformed entries should fail.
requested_regression_tests: Missing/renamed checkpoint-2000 metadata fails even when the 1000 baseline survives.
Missing/empty registry and missing/changed gzip fail.
A wave2 raw edit fails while valid, explicitly declared selected-core disposition remains allowed.
findings.author_response: Parent acknowledged and plans a required checkpoints.json registry; not yet fixed in these reviewed hashes.

findings.title: New candidates may omit the entire editorial block
findings.trigger: A new wave3 candidate omits editorial rather than supplying a malformed block.
findings.evidence: validateEditorial({id:"V9999"}) returned successfully. The caller does not distinguish new IDs from historical immutable rows. Bounds checks correctly rejected reversed, zero, over-600 and fractional seconds when a block existed.
findings.impact: The new payoff, visual and segment-time requirement can be skipped entirely, leaving new material unassessed for the requested film-length and boredom screening.
findings.required_change: Only exempt raw IDs present in the frozen 2000 checkpoint. Require editorial for other new candidates while retaining historical raw rows byte-for-byte.
requested_regression_tests: Historical frozen raw IDs may retain missing editorial.
New ID with valid role/payoff/visual and integer ordered second range passes.
Invalid or empty role/payoff/visual and invalid seconds fail.
findings.author_response: Parent acknowledged and plans to use checkpoint-2000 frozen raw IDs for the exception; not yet fixed in these reviewed hashes.

verified_behavior.evidence: Actual pinned local ONNX model processed three new Chinese fixture questions in one padded batch. Independently indexing only nonpadding hidden states, taking their mean and normalizing agreed with semantic.py to max absolute error 2.9802322387695312e-08. No shared cache writes; no network calls.
verified_behavior.limits: Small correctness fixture, not a semantic-quality benchmark or full-pool rerun.

verified_behavior.evidence: Both installed files matched the hardcoded SHA-256 values. prepare uses an immutable model revision, verifies a downloaded .part before replacement, and normal runs reverify model bytes before reading input.
verified_behavior.limits: Downloaded files were not fetched again; remote outage or interrupted HTTP streaming was not simulated.

verified_behavior.evidence: Temporary cache roundtrip, namespace invalidation, changed matrix digest rejection, invalid dimension rejection, NaN rejection and nonunit norm rejection passed. Simulating interruption at metadata-temp replacement retained the previous metadata bytes and readable previous matrix.

resolved_findings.resolution: checkpointFiles requires a nonempty unique safe-name registry; editorial_baseline must be in its list. Intake hashes the registry, every listed metadata and snapshot; validateCheckpoints iterates that required list.
resolved_findings.independent_reproduction: Original temporary-checkpoint fixture updated to include the registry: intact checkpoint passed; changed B2050 failed; renaming the temporary metadata now threw ENOENT rather than returning an empty list. Actual snapshots remained untouched.

resolved_findings.resolution: Editorial required defaults true; intake derives the sole exception from raw IDs in the hash-verified frozen editorial baseline. Missing fields on a new ID now fail. Historical records retain their original fields.
resolved_findings.independent_reproduction: validateEditorial({id:"V9999"}) rejected. Live read-only intake accepted 2661 draft raw rows and its inputs bound checkpoints.json to exact current bytes.
